description: Cogitate (2025): none of 655 prefrontal iEEG electrodes showed the GNWT onset-and-offset profile (BF01 > 3 for all), though 99 showed onset responses and the same model detected onset-offset profiles in 10 visual-cortex electrodes.
limitations: One adversarial study of visual consciousness with suprathreshold faces, objects, letters and false fonts. Tests only the predictions both teams preregistered.

sources.quote: However, none of the 655 electrodes measured the temporal profile predicted by GNWT (that is, onset and offset).
